newsitem.title: USA: RICHFOOD IN 5-YEAR SUPPLY PACT WITH UKROP'S.
newsitem.headline: RICHFOOD IN 5-YEAR SUPPLY PACT WITH UKROP'S.

text.p: Richfood Holdings Inc, reporting rising earnings in the quarter ended July 26, said Wednesday it entered into a new five-year $1.2 billion supply agreement with Ukrop's Super Markets Inc.

The supply deal, which became effective August 3, calls for Ukrop's to buy $1.2 billion of goods from Richfood over five years. Richfood said it will continue to be Ukrop's principal source of wholesale supply for its 25 supermarkets in the Richmond, Va., area.

The wholesale food distributor posted a net income of $14.5 million, or $0.31 a share, for its first quarter ended July 26. This compared with a $12.4 million net, or $0.26 a share, in the 1996 quarter.

Sales for the quarter decreased 1.9 percent to $739.1 million from 753.4 million. The company attributed the drop to the expiration of its long-term supply contract with Acme Markets Inc in June, which ws partly offset by sales to new customers and increased sales at its Norristown Wholesale produce business.
The company's stock traded at 23-15/16 Wedneday morning, up 3/16.
